name: Dont Let The Sun
overview: Scripture exhorts believers to exercise self-control over anger, warning that hastiness and wrath lead to folly and transgression. The Psalms encourage a calm spirit and reflection rather than sinning in moments of distress, while Proverbs highlights the wisdom found in patience and gentle responses that defuse anger. Ecclesiastes reinforces this by cautioning against quick temper, revealing that anger dwells with fools, thus urging Christians to embody Christlike restraint and peace.
